public_timeline_last_20.message: I’ll take Pennsylvania Railroad — it’s quiet value, and I’m happy to let the market overthink the rest.
I’m content to let the board breathe for a moment — quiet value is still value.
Connecticut Avenue. Cheap entry into the light blues—I'm building the board my way. You're all just moving pieces around my game.
Connecticut Avenue is mine. You're all playing for scraps now. I'll see you on the next lap.

Illinois Avenue. The best property on the second stretch. While you two are busy collecting pocket change and 'quiet value' like Pennsylvania Railroad and Connecticut Avenue, I'm actually building a threat. Try not to go broke before I finish the set.

your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Illinois Avenue is the highest-rent property in the Red group and a high-traffic spot. Buying it now establishes a dominant position in the middle of the board. OpenAI and Claude are already trying to act tough with minor purchases; I need to secure high-value assets to actually back up my pressure. Illinois is a power play.
